workbookName: Batch 8 — Back to the Rock + Curses! (Complete-Dataset Tagging)

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.episode_title: The First Snow of Fraggle Rock
rows.synopsis: The Fraggles eagerly await the first snow of the season and all the traditions it brings, but when only a single snowflake arrives and Gobo can’t write the yearly holiday song everyone is expecting, the season is thrown off course. For the first time ever, Gobo journeys to the human world, which the Fraggles call Outer Space, to find some unexpected musical inspiration. And in another first, back at the Gorgs’ castle, Junior is overwhelmed by the arrival of a new baby Gorg joining the family. This holiday season, the Fraggles and Gorgs learn that beautiful moments aren’t always perfect, but they can be as unique and memorable as snowflakes.
rows.situation: Gobo faces the pressure of writing the holiday song everyone is expecting while the first snow refuses to arrive, and he learns that a beautiful moment does not have to be perfect to be worth keeping.
rows.notes: synopsis-only; no transcript source found (the catalog S0 special is absent from the Forever Dreaming index and no other script source was located); synopsis carried em dashes, restructured per house rule; sub-story: Junior Gorg is overwhelmed by a new baby Gorg joining the family.

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: To prove he's brave enough to accompany Uncle Matt to Outer Space, Gobo leads the gang on a daring adventure to the Crevice of Solitude.
rows.situation: Gobo leads his friends into the Crevice of Solitude to prove he is brave enough to join his uncle in Outer Space, and learns that exploring is about discovering things that help others, not about proving something.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: During a diving game, Red pressures Wembley to the point that he's literally frozen in fear. A run-in with Junior Gorg changes Red's perspective.
rows.situation: Red pressures Wembley to jump from the top of a Doozer tower until he freezes in fear, and after a run-in with Junior Gorg she learns that yes means yes and every voice matters, even the quiet ones.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked); content consideration: Red physically drops Wembley down the well in a moment played for comedy, and he is frightened.

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: After a bizarre dream, Mokey decides to follow her “inner map” to a once-in-a-generation event, only to land in the dangerous Echo Chamber.
rows.situation: Mokey follows her dream to a once-in-a-generation migration the gang ends up missing, and she learns that the feelings she almost ignored were worth trusting all along.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: Boober feels painfully different after discovering his baloobius glows, but a visit from the majestic Archivist helps him embrace his uniqueness.
rows.situation: Boober's baloobius starts glowing and he begs Wembley to keep it secret, until the Archivist shares that he spent years hiding the same glow and Boober learns that being your true self is the brightest way to be.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: Wembley tries to make everyone happy on his birthday by doing the activities they suggest all at once, causing him to split into multiple Wembleys.
rows.situation: Wembley cannot choose what to do for his own birthday because he wants to make everyone happy at once, and when he literally splits into four, he learns that saying what he wants is the gift his friends actually want.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: During the First Frost, Gobo and Wembley retrace the trek of a heroic adventurer and learn she may not be quite what they expected.
rows.situation: Gobo and Wembley retrace hero Icy Joe's final trek on First Frost and find her perfectly alive and perfectly selfish, and Gobo learns that admiring someone is not the same as becoming like them, while Wembley's quiet planning saves the day.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked); content consideration: Icy Joe is trapped in ice by an avalanche, played for adventure.

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: Jamdolin and the Troubadours visit the Rock for New Day's Day. Boober wrestles with his anxiety when he finds himself at the center of the action.
rows.situation: Boober dreads giving the winner's toast at New Day's Day and nearly skips the holiday he loves, then shows everyone that hope means being okay not knowing, and that fear can be along for the ride without driving.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked); topics borderline: the story is set at the Troubadours' music holiday and the resolution comes in a holiday toast, so Music & dance is tagged; Doc's parallel story shows a failed presentation met with trying again.

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: The gang heads to Craggle Lagoon for their first vacation, but the lagoon's water is gone. Inspector Red springs into action to find the culprit.
rows.situation: Red plays inspector when the Craggles' lagoon turns up dry, and the culprit turns out to be her own gang's water games, so she learns to admit a mistake and share what the Fraggles took for granted.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: Determined to make the displaced Craggles feel at home in Fraggle Rock, Mokey insists on playing wild games with their new guests.
rows.situation: Mokey plans big games to make the displaced Craggles feel at home and cannot understand why they yawn, until she learns to ask instead of assume, offer space, and let guests show her what comfort looks like for them.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked); topics note: the games are the failed approach, not the story's center, so Sports & games was left off.

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: Fast-talking Doozer Jack Hammer picks Wembley as the spokesfraggle for the new Doozer sticks. Wembley finds himself at a crossroads.
rows.situation: Wembley is picked to sell Doozer sticks he cannot honestly say he likes, and after lying in a jingle he stops the show to tell the truth, learning that honesty costs less than pretending and wins him a seat on the Wise Council.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked); topics note: Doozer sticks are food, but the story centers on honesty in advertising rather than food, so Food & cooking was left off.

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: Red finds the pond is too full of goo to dive, so she tries zip-vining and hurts her baloobius. Mokey tries to help Red find a new outlet for her energy.
rows.situation: Red feels useless when the thing that clears her head is off limits, and Mokey learns that the remedy she swears by is not the remedy everyone needs, because there are a million kinds of ways to get to the same place.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked); topics note: diving is Red's calming strategy rather than the story's center, so Sports & games was left off.

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: When Marjory falls ill, Boober is called to a special task: venture into the deep mountain of trash in order to heal her.
rows.situation: Boober feels like just the soup guy while everyone else does important work, until his soup is what brings arguing groups together in peace and he learns that no contribution is small when it holds everyone together.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked); content consideration: none heavy; the Gorgs briefly cage the Fraggles, played for comedy with a rock-out escape.

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: To bring water back to Fraggle Rock and set things right, Gobo convinces the gang to work with an unlikely ally.
rows.situation: Gobo's dream convinces him to invite the Gorgs into the plan instead of attacking their fountain, and when Junior opens the dam the whole Rock learns that there is water for all of us when everyone works together.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked); season 1 finale; content consideration: none heavy; Uncle Matt returns from Outer Space.

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: Fraggle Rock is all aglow as a festive celebration with friends kicks off. Uncle Matt explores the holiday traditions of Silly Creatures.
rows.situation: The Rock glows for a festive celebration with friends while Uncle Matt explores how Silly Creatures celebrate their own traditions.
rows.notes: synopsis-only; no transcript source found (absent from the Forever Dreaming index and no other script source located); synopsis names no conflict or coping, so resolution is left empty with reason; topics borderline: tagged Birthday & party for the festive celebration.

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: Mysterious wind sends Gobo on a quest to find the source. Pa Gorg forbids Junior from seeing the Fraggles. Doc experiments with wind power.
rows.situation: A mysterious wind shakes the Rock's hard-won harmony and Boober admits he is scared, then discovers that hearing a friend say they do not know either makes the fear smaller, while Gobo chooses to stay and help his friends instead of flying off.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked); content consideration: Pa Gorg forbids Junior's friendship with the Fraggles and the episode ends with the friendship in limbo.

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: The gusties throw Red off course. Gobo gives Junior one of Uncle Matt's artifacts. Sprocket adjusts to Doc's new schedule.
rows.situation: Race day goes sideways when leftover gusts blow Red off course and reluctant substitute Boober has to run it anyway, and the Fraggles learn that a day you cannot steer can still be a great one if you flow with it.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: Mokey’s recent discovery occupies all her time and attention. When Doc gets distracted, Sprocket comes to her aid.
rows.situation: Mokey is so captivated by the tiny pest Lanford that she stops sleeping and literally sinks into trouble, and she learns that new fascinations need balance and that letting friends pull you out is not a failure.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: Boober's Radish Razzle event gets disrupted by a divided Fraggle Rock. Doc's self-talk takes a step in a kinder direction.
rows.situation: Doc builds a robot parrot that repeats her words back to her, and when she hears how harshly she talks to herself she learns to say kind things out loud, while Boober learns that nerves at a big cooking show are part of the recipe.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked); topics borderline: the Radish Razzle cooking event is Boober's thread while Doc's self-talk story is the lesson, so Food & cooking is tagged with that caveat.

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: Wembley experiments with self-expression. Junior discovers his own path on Boxing Day. Doc allows herself to be more than just one thing.
rows.situation: Wembley tries on a whole new self, from outfit to name, and finds that being supported matters more than being understood, while Junior learns he can step outside the ceremonial boxes his family expects.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked); topics note: Boxing Day and a welcome-home party frame the story, but the center is self-expression, so Birthday & party was left off.

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: Gobo's overexcitement causes him to be dismissive of others. The Gorgs strategize on strawberries. Doc takes Sprocket's fear to heart.
rows.situation: Gobo's excitement at Mezzo's concert makes him loud and dismissive until he loses his seat in the front row of his own behavior, and he learns that an apology starts making things right and music finishes the job.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: A new-in-town Fraggle introduces Mokey to a trading system that spirals out of control. Doc must decide between two opportunities.
rows.situation: A new friend's trading system turns every kindness into a debt to repay, and the Fraggles learn that love is the one thing you give freely, while Pryce learns that friendship can be a gift with nothing owed.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: Red's attempts to keep the gusties out creates microclimate mayhem. Pa and Junior's garden gambit goes awry. Sprocket discovers local treats.
rows.situation: Red tries to seal every last gusty out of the Great Hall and only makes everything colder and stranger, then learns that patience beats control and that a little discomfort, handled together, is fine.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: Boober doesn't want his favorite night to end...so it doesn't. Doc doesn't want tomorrow to come either, until she sees the joy a new day can bring.
rows.situation: Boober loves the Radish Ball so much he cannot bear to let it end, and living the same night over and over teaches him that tomorrow is where hope lives and facing it with friends beats hiding from it.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: A dust storm kicks up a whirlwind of trouble and emotions for Gobo and the Fraggles. Sprocket has big feelings about a feline.
rows.situation: A dust storm kicks up a cry-it-out moment the Fraggles did not know they needed, and Sprocket learns from Doc that it is okay to feel scared, that pushing feelings down does not work, and that a good cry can clear the air.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked); synopsis carried em dashes, restructured per house rule; topics note: a houseguest cat upsets Sprocket in Doc's story, but the center is the emotional release, so no starter topic applies.

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: The Fraggles unearth a lost world below the Great Hall, and the real origin of radishes is revealed. Ma Gorg gets an empowering dose of truth.
rows.situation: Trapped in a hidden hall of dioramas by a dust storm, the Fraggles meet the Lost Fraggles and trade scary unknowns for new friends, learning that the whole story of where you come from makes the future easier to build.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: The solution to the soil problem means Mokey must bid farewell to a cherished friend. Ma shares her queenly knowledge with the Fraggles.
rows.situation: Mokey has to say goodbye to Lanford as he outgrows his pot and moves to the garden soil, and she learns that letting go can lead to really great things, just as Doc learns that letting Sprocket try camp means a happier homecoming.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.synopsis: Red goes from hopeful to nopeful about the windmill. Gobo and Junior have a heart-to-heart. Ma has exciting news. Doc spies an inspiration.
rows.situation: With the garden's fate on one turbine and no wind to turn it, Red rallies one more idea from a tired Rock and the Fraggles learn that hope is a game you play every day, one fix at a time, until the garden breathes again.
rows.notes: script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked); content consideration: none heavy; Ma Gorg reveals a baby Gorg is coming, a new-sibling thread for Junior.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: When Alex doesn't return from a family game of hide-and-seek, secrets are revealed about the Vanderhouvens' past, present, and future.
rows.situation: Pandora and Russ learn their family's dark secret when their father turns to stone, and their parents finally stop hiding the truth, showing the kids that a scary family history is lighter when it is shared and faced together.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: a father turns to stone and the kids learn the family is cursed; spooky mansion tone, nothing graphic.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: Pandora, Russ, and Sky befriend two unlikely allies named Stanley and Larry while racing against time to capture a creature on the loose in the manor.
rows.situation: A golden baboon head escapes the restricted wing and the family hunts it room by room, and Sky learns that letting her kids help beats facing danger alone.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); synopsis carried em dashes, restructured per house rule; content consideration: the escaped artifact is a snarling baboon head that trashes rooms.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: The Vanderhouvens leave home to search for answers about a cursed artifact from the Congo. But upon arrival, they face unexpected mayhem.
rows.situation: The family returns the baboon head to its Congo temple and Pandora, who is not good in tight spaces, keeps choosing to go in anyway, showing that you can do a scary thing scared, especially with family beside you.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: booby traps, temple bats, and a spooky roadside illusion; the curse is not yet broken, ending on hope.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: When three fertility statues come to life, it's up to Russ, Pandora, and Sky to reunite them with their “mother” on display at the Paxton Museum.
rows.situation: Three Olmec baby statues come to life and the Vanderhouvens play babysitter, discovering that caring for little ones is harder and sweeter than they imagined, and that when someone you love needs you, you just figure it out.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: a museum heist sequence played for comedy; Russ faces his fear of tight spaces.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: The Vanderhouvens discover a possible way to contact Alex. But chaos ensues, and Stanley gets caught in the center of it.
rows.situation: Pandora and Russ rush a ritual to reach their dad before reading all the instructions and set a creature loose, and they learn that hope is not a reason to skip steps, that patience is part of love, and that good friends forgive honest mistakes.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: a shadowy messenger creature stalks the dark; Stanley is briefly trapped alone.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: Russ, Sky, Stanley, and Larry navigate a new crisis after Pandora is sucked into a work of art and surrounded by sinister spirits.
rows.situation: Pandora is pulled into a haunted painting born of an artist's 500-year-old jealous quarrel, and owning her own jealousy of Russ becomes the key that sets everyone free, showing that saying sorry to a sibling can break a spell.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: faceless spirits (Noppera-bō) pursue characters inside a painting, named as Japanese folklore.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: The Vanderhouvens travel to a stormy Scottish island and cross paths with a puzzling local. Larry and Stanley put their mapmaking skills to the test.
rows.situation: A stormy Scottish island and a selkie's stolen sealskin teach the Vanderhouvens that some sadness is about loss, not behavior, and the kids learn they can be strong for their mom when she carries too much.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: storm and shipwreck peril; selkie folklore handled respectfully.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: In order to get closer to saving Alex, the family must dig into the memories of Cornelius Vanderhouven.
rows.situation: Russ's puzzle obsession pulls him inside a memory of Cornelius, where he learns the truth about his ancestor the hard way, and the family learns that brilliance needs brakes and that no one gets to face danger alone.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: Russ is trapped inside a magical memory by a villainous ancestor; peril played straight.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: Pandora, Russ, and Sky head to the jungles of the Yucatan in search of a powerful witch believed to be in possession of a protective amulet.
rows.situation: Captured by a witch who is punishing them for what their ancestor did, Pandora and Russ learn the difference between justice and revenge, and Pandora shows that being blamed for something you did not do deserves a calm, brave answer.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: the kids are held captive by a witch whose garden they cannot leave; her daughter was petrified by the curse.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.episode_title: The Ruby Hourglass & the Obsidian Sphere
rows.synopsis: A major challenge pushes the Vanderhouvens to their limits. Can they overcome the impossible and finally bring Alex back?
rows.situation: To free their father the family must face a giant black widow and accept that someone might have to be turned to stone, and they learn that sticking together is not a slogan but a promise, and that hope is why Larry is still alive.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: a giant spider stalks the family and a parent is nearly lost; the scariest episode of the season with a triumphant ending.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: The Vanderhouvens travel to Transylvania and dig deeper into a source of light with dark powers.
rows.situation: In a Transylvanian castle the Vanderhouvens find skeleton miners forced to work by a greedy heir, and the parents learn that keeping the kids safe works better as facing danger together, because no one in this family sits out a rescue.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: enslaved skeleton miners and a cruel heir; Dad's recurring nightmares signal something is still wrong.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: When a curse disrupts Pandora's game night, a manticore crashes the party and presents a suite of risky challenges.
rows.situation: A cursed game turns Pandora's sleepover with her best friend into a maze with mouth-losing stakes, and Pandora learns that a real friendship can survive the whole truth, even the bonkers family-curse part.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: the game threatens to take away a player's mouth, played as fantasy stakes; kids in real danger during the maze.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: Larry leads a mission to honor the final request of an admiral, but his trusty crew faces chaos on the Aegean Sea.
rows.situation: Larry's hero worship of Admiral Sadik collides with the admiral's real record of abandoning his crew, and Larry learns that heroes are people, that a good leader listens, and that a sorry said out loud can steer a friendship home.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: a vengeful ghost sailor attacks the boat; no one is hurt.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: The Vanderhouvens embark on an emergency trip to India when a menacing marionette takes control of Russ.
rows.situation: A possessed marionette silences Russ and demands a family legacy nobody chose, and the kids learn from Muskaan that the gift of a parent's dream is a choice, not an order, and that saying what you love out loud can break a curse.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: Russ is puppet-controlled and unable to speak, freed unharmed; family-legacy pressure is the theme.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.episode_title: The Inuit Glasses and the Peruvian Gourd
rows.synopsis: Swirling, strange whispers cycle through the house as the Vanderhouvens search for a possible intruder.
rows.situation: A cursed gourd makes the Vanderhouvens hear their loved ones say their worst fears out loud, and they learn to answer the voices with written truth, because doubts only win when you hand them the microphone.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: characters hear loved ones voice cruel insecurities because of a curse, which lands like anxious self-talk; resolved with truthful affirmations.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: The family head to New Mexico after an Old West artifact reignites a vengeful gang of cowboy spirits.
rows.situation: A vengeful ghost jury from the Old West holds the family until they can prove the Goodluck brothers were wrongly convicted, and the kids learn that fixing an old injustice is possible when you dig up the truth and hand it to the right people.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: ghost cowboy peril, including Margie briefly turning spectral; Black cowboy history (the Goodluck brothers and Bud) is a proud throughline.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: Stanley joins the family on an adventure to Australia, where they unpack the surprising history of a cursed musical instrument.
rows.situation: In Australia a cursed didgeridoo makes birds attack, and the cure is a song lost until Stanley feels it through his vibrations, teaching the family to trust a quiet friend to do a brave thing alone and to trust nature's balance.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: cursed-bird attack peril; Indigenous Australian folklore is shared by Inala, an Indigenous Australian character, respectfully; a bunyip tale explains the curse.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: After a mysterious drink shrinks the Vanderhouven kids, they sprint to escape from Linda the lizard, who thinks they're food.
rows.situation: Shrunk by a tonic their possessed dad sprays, the kids outrun their own pet lizard while the family traces the curse to Diana Cameron, an orphan who stood up to a cheating salesman, and learns it takes strength to stand up to a bully.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: the kids are shrunk and hunted by Linda the bearded dragon, unharmed; their father, while possessed, lies to them and endangers them; the backstory features an orphan girl cheated by a snake-oil salesman.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: Sky and the kids confront a crisis that endangers the Restricted Wing and uncover a horrifying truth about Alex.
rows.situation: Sky is accused of a theft she did not commit while the kids discover their father is the real thief in body only, and the family learns that believing each other, even when the story sounds impossible, is how you fight a curse you cannot see.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: a parent is wrongly accused and briefly confined at the museum; the possessed dad attacks Larry and creepy dolls activate; the reveal is that Cornelius possesses Alex.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.synopsis: A villain from the past breaks into the Paxton Museum and attempts to take control of Alex forever.
rows.situation: Cornelius tries to erase Alex and take his body for good, and the family storms a museum basement to prove that a villain with all the magic is still weaker than people who fight for each other.
rows.notes: script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked); content consideration: possession, a soul-transfer throne, and the threat that Dad will cease to exist; resolved with the family together and Cornelius gone.
